name: Wukong
title: the Monkey King

Q.name: Crushing Blow
Q.description: Wukong and his Clone's next Attack gains 135/145/155/165/175 range, deals an additional 20/45/70/95/120 + 0.5×bonus AD physical damage, and removes 10/15/20/25/30% Armor for 3 seconds. This Ability's cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds every time Wukong or his Clone hit an enemy with an Attack or Ability. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.
Q.summary: Wukong's next attack gains attack range, deals bonus damage, and reduces the target's armor for a few seconds.

W.name: Warrior Trickster
W.description: Wukong dashes and becomes Invisible for 1 second, leaving behind a stationary Clone for 4 seconds. The Clone Attacks nearby enemies Wukong has recently damaged and will mimic his ultimate, each dealing 40/45/50/55.0/60% of normal damage.
W.summary: Wukong becomes Invisible and dashes in a direction, leaving behind a clone that will attack nearby enemies.

E.name: Nimbus Strike
E.description: Wukong dashes to an enemy, sending out Clones that mimic the dash to up to 2 additional enemies nearby. Each enemy struck takes 80/120/160/200/240 + 1×AP magic damage. He and his Clone gain 40/45/50/55.0/60% Attack Speed for 5 seconds.
E.summary: Wukong dashes to a targeted enemy and sends out images to attack enemies near his target, dealing damage to each enemy struck.

R.name: Cyclone
R.description: Wukong gains 20% Move Speed and spins his staff, Knocking Up nearby enemies for 0.6 seconds and take (1.375×AD) × 2 plus (26c20668) × 2 max Health physical damage over 2 seconds. This Ability can be cast a second time within 8 seconds before going on cooldown.
R.summary: Wukong's extends his staff and spins it around repeatedly, gaining Move Speed. Enemies struck take damage and are knocked up.

Passive.name: Stone Skin
Passive.description: Wukong gains stacking armor and max health regeneration while fighting champions and monsters.
Passive.summary: Wukong gains stacking armor and max health regeneration while fighting champions and monsters.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Bruiser who disrupts teamfights with R spin knock-up and tricks enemies with W decoy. Wins lane with Q empowered attack and E dash.
strengths: R knocks up nearby enemies twice
W decoy and invisibility dodges turret aggro
E dash with bonus attack speed
weaknesses: Q and W are short range
profile.windowAgainst: R on cooldown or W used.
checks: Whether W gives invisibility vs stealth types for detection.
